text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of our outing, we came to take part in an interactive game event
at an atmospheric Western-style mansion.
Its name: "Extreme Mystery Maze"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I wonder what lies in wait for us.
Well, since we applied together, we're on the same team,
but what about the remaining two...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Ho, it is you lot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Happy New Year!
What fine weather we're having today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Geh. Are you serious, this is so annoying...! It's already some new game where I can't read what's coming next...
choice_data_list: Let's all do our best, yeah!
Let's all do our best together, okay!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: “—Now, solve the hidden mystery! Combine the answers and deduce the passcode! But beware... you must walk the path of deception!”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I see, the rules are similar to a classic escape room.
However, what could this "deception" be...?
And this passcode—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (It will probably form a sentence, right? In that case, I can deduce it to some degree... Fascinating! In that case, there are roughly eight possible strategies I can conceive of, but—)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at that!
Isn't that a golden stag beetle?!
Net! Give me the net! It's gonna get away!
choice_data_list: H-hey, you two! It's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Let the game begin!
Will you be able to see through to the true nature of this riddle—!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!
Everyone's already started!
I got totally and completely left behind~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Fools.
I shall take my leave."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, a huge crowd had already gathered
in front of the nearby puzzle.
Even standing on my tiptoes, I can't see a thing...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, this is the worst...!
What is this, a trash game?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's 'cause you spent forever thinking, man~
The gold-dusted snail got away too!
Haah! Give me a break!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Quit your shrieking.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is only one thing you must do.
—Make up for it, swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, well said!
You hear that, Ruler!
Give us some kinda strategy☆

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
How did it turn into that!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You're good at that kind of stuff, aren't you?
You pulled one over on me before, after all."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
O ruler of the board—
show me that tactical brilliance once more.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh, well that's a surprise.
You sure hold my intellect in high regard.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
However, before my grand design,
even you are nothing more than a single pawn.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just for now, follow my every command...
How about you become my pawn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Rulership made the two of them
run all the way to the ends of the western-style mansion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While other teams are solving the riddles starting closest to the start point, Rulership's plan is to simply "skip" them...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You sure about that?
If we just gather the riddles the others found, it'll save us search time, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Conversely, if you find it in front of the other participants, they'll just free-ride on your effort... Have you forgotten the crowd from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we shall first investigate
the mysteries of the area no one has visited yet.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That was the key to this game.
Come to think of it, the clue was there right from the start...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There were a few parts of the passcode
that could be deduced.
You don't need to solve every single mystery.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case...
If I were making the riddles, I'd hide the important clues far away.
And in a place that's hard to find, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The more significant the mystery, the more time it takes
to find and solve it. Therefore, the optimal solution is
to 'discard the trivial questions and go all-in on the hardest one'!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I'll focus on deciphering the riddles
those two sent over.
Trainer, I'm counting on you as our messenger!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as time was almost running out,
the frustrated voices of other participants
began to echo around...!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
"Did you finally find the last puzzle?!"
"Guh, this looks tough~!"
"There's barely any time left to solve it...!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I cracked it!
This is the passcode!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Passcode check... Correct!
Congratulations!
You're the first to clear it!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
All righttttt!!
...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! Hahahahaha!
This is precisely why I am the master of the board!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership laughs triumphantly.
Seeing her show true skill reminded me once again of just how incredible she is.
choice_data_list: A lot happened, but it was fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership laughs triumphantly.
Seeing her show true skill reminded me once again of just how incredible she is.
choice_data_list: A lot happened, but it was fun!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
Well, my own carelessness brought this about.
This should save some face, at least.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation,
in the end, I'm the one who's gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, wouldn't you say?
It's nothing to be praised for, really.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the envious look in your eyes isn't bad at all.
I'll take it as a compliment."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... hahaha!
Well, fair enough.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It was quite fun getting to move such strong pieces as I pleased.
My thanks to all of you, senpais."
